text: See parent PKIX-lwr9 comment of 2026-05-11. The 25-fixture characterization harness landed by PKIX-lwr9.1 shows pkix-path-builder PASSES 23 of 25 representative cases — the 47-failure figure in baseline-limbo.json is at the pkix-difftest harness layer, which never invokes pkix-path-builder. Verify the path-builder is actually broken on the relevant failure-mode bucket before claiming this bead; the heuristic work may not be needed if the limbo harness gets a build_path step (option (a) in the parent comment).
